subject: Next steps: rotating demo slots across US/EU/APAC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jake Thompson <jake@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@globridge.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: rotating demo slots across US/EU/APAC

Hi Jake / Priya —

Great to meet you both on the discovery call today. Quick recap: Acme is focused on improving search relevance across international markets and reducing inference cost for production reranking. Next step from our side is a technical deep dive / demo (30–45m) where we can show a candidate integration pattern and discuss throughput targets.

To make scheduling fair for teams across regions, we recommend rotating the meeting windows weekly so the burden of late/early calls is shared across Acme and Redwood teams. Here are a few proposed rotating slots (all converted):

Option A (Week 1: Americas-friendly)
- Wed Jul 28, 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 17:00 UTC / 18:00 CET
Option B (Week 2: Europe-friendly)
- Wed Aug 4, 10:00 CET / 09:00 BST / 04:00 PT / 07:00 ET
Option C (Week 3: APAC overlap)
- Thu Aug 12, 08:00 SGT / 01:00 UTC / Wed Aug 11 18:00 PT

If that pattern works we can rotate Week 1->Week 2->Week 3 and repeat, or pick whichever two windows you prefer. I added a short working agenda below:
- 5m: quick introductions and constraints
- 20–30m: demo of integration (end-to-end flow, perf expectations)
- 5–10m: Q&A and next steps / mutual action plan

Please mark preferred options or send a few of your team’s available time blocks and we’ll lock the invite. You can also pick a slot directly on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/60

Attachment: Acme-MAP-v1.0.pdf (draft mutual action plan)

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference | developer-first LLM inference

From: Jake Thompson <jake@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@globridge.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 10:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Next steps: rotating demo slots across US/EU/APAC

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the options. Overall this pattern sounds good. For Acme, EU-friendly windows are easiest for our engineering leads — Option B looks best right now. Priya (cc) and our backend lead can make Aug 4 at 10:00 CET.

A couple of asks before the demo:
- Can you confirm what data (sample logs, expected token volumes) you’d like us to share ahead of time?
- Any preference for the environment for the demo (hosted vs. dedicated instance)?

If Option B is confirmed we’ll block the time on our side.

Cheers,
Jake
Director of Product, Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jake Thompson <jake@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@globridge.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: rotating demo slots across US/EU/APAC

Great — thanks Jake.

Quick answers:
- Data: a representative sample of queries (CSV or redacted logs) and a rough daily QPS figure is ideal. If you can drop files in the Drive link I shared we’ll pull them into the demo environment.
- Environment: we’ll demo against our hosted sandbox but will show how Dedicated/private deployments map to the same APIs. If you prefer we can also stage a dedicated instance — Aditya, Camila, can you confirm capacity if Acme asks for a dedicated demo instance the week of Aug 4?

Tentative: I’ll provision the demo for Tue Aug 4 10:00 CET (which is Wed Aug 4 04:00 PT) and send an invite; if that creates timezone confusion we can alter. Priya / Jake — please confirm you’re happy with Aug 4 10:00 CET and I’ll finalize.

On the rotating cadence — we recommend continuing the rotate after this demo so different stakeholders aren’t always on late calls. We’ll add the mutual action plan to the Drive.

Thanks,
Marissa

Thanks — quick internal update. We can support a dedicated staging instance for the demo week of Aug 4. I’ll carve out a small cluster and Camila will help with the integration checklist.

For the meeting time, Aug 4 10:00 CET works on engineering side (Aditya + Camila). Marissa — please send the invite for Tue Aug 4 10:00 CET / 04:00 PT and include the Google Drive link with sample data.

We’ll also note the rotating cadence in the MAP so stakeholders know we’ll alternate windows.

-Aditya
